title: Traffic Sign Knockdown
description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report knocked down or missing stop signs, yield signs or one-way signs only. Place all other signs on Traffic Sign - Maintenance (Other). The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 business day.
instructions: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report knocked down or missing stop signs, yield signs or one-way signs only. Place all other signs on Traffic Sign - Maintenance (Other). The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 business day. Please call 311 for more information

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about a downed stop, yield, or one-way sign.
actions.why: For a knocked-down or missing stop, yield, or one-way traffic sign. This request must be dispatched; its saved instructions direct people to call 311.
actions.why_not: This call-in service is limited to stop, yield, and one-way signs. If another traffic sign needs maintenance, then submit a "Traffic Sign Maintenance (Other)" 311 request instead.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about another damaged or missing traffic sign.
actions.why: For a downed or missing traffic sign other than a stop, yield, or one-way sign, such as a street-name or speed-limit sign, when the issue is nonhazardous. The Traffic Sign Knockdown instructions direct all other sign types to traffic-sign maintenance.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Sign Maintenance (Other)"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Sign Maintenance (Other)"
